title: Booking
question: What should happen when a customer books an appointment?

options.label: Open WhatsApp to contact the business
included: A "Book now" button that opens a WhatsApp chat with the business
excluded: Booking forms, availability calendar, and booking records on the website
acceptanceCriteria: Tapping "Book now" opens WhatsApp with a pre-filled greeting to the business's number

preview.title: Customer taps Book now
preview.body: The button sits on every service page.

preview.title: WhatsApp opens
preview.body: "Hi, I'd like to book a haircut." is ready to send.

preview.title: The business replies by chat
preview.body: Date and time are agreed in the conversation, outside the website.

options.label: Submit a request for staff approval
included: A booking request form: service, preferred date and time, name, phone
A staff list of requests with Pending and Confirmed status
clientResponsibilities: Review new requests daily and confirm or decline them
acceptanceCriteria: Customers enter a service and a requested date
A new request has status Pending
Only after staff approve does the status become Confirmed

preview.title: "Request sent"
preview.body: "We will confirm your time shortly." Status: Pending.

preview.title: Staff confirm
preview.body: Staff approve the request; the customer's status becomes Confirmed.

options.label: Reserve an available slot immediately
included: A live availability calendar per service and staff member
Instant booking that blocks the chosen slot
clientResponsibilities: Keep opening hours, services, durations, and staff schedules up to date
acceptanceCriteria: Customers only see free slots
Choosing a slot confirms the booking instantly
A booked slot is no longer offered to anyone else

preview.title: Booked instantly
preview.body: "Confirmed for Sat 14:00." The slot disappears for everyone else.

options.label: Every page, translated by the client
included: A language switch on every page
Both language versions of every page
clientResponsibilities: Provide the translated text for every page before launch
acceptanceCriteria: Every page has a working language switch
Every page shows the client-provided text in both languages

options.label: Every page, translated by the freelancer
included: A language switch on every page
Translation of all page text by the freelancer
clientResponsibilities: Review the translations within the agreed review round
acceptanceCriteria: Every page has a working language switch
All page text is available in both languages

options.label: Main pages only
included: Second language for the home, services, and contact pages
clientResponsibilities: Provide the translated text for the main pages
acceptanceCriteria: Home, services, and contact pages switch languages
Other pages stay in the main language

title: Editable content
question: What can the client change after launch, without the freelancer?

options.label: Text and photos on every page
included: An editor where the client can change text and photos on every page
excluded: Changing page layout or adding new page types
clientResponsibilities: Keep their own edits accurate after launch
acceptanceCriteria: The client can log in and change text and photos on any page
Changes appear on the live site without the freelancer

options.label: Services and prices only
included: An editor for the list of services and prices
excluded: Editing other text, photos, or pages
clientResponsibilities: Keep services and prices up to date
acceptanceCriteria: The client can add, edit, and remove services and prices
Other page content cannot be edited by the client

options.label: Nothing — send changes to the freelancer
included: Content changes handled by the freelancer on request
clientResponsibilities: Send change requests to the freelancer
acceptanceCriteria: The site has no client login
Change requests go to the freelancer

title: Launch content
question: Who provides the text and photos at launch?

options.label: Client provides all
included: Placing the client's text and photos into the pages
clientResponsibilities: Deliver all page text and photos before design starts
acceptanceCriteria: Every page uses text and photos provided by the client

options.label: Freelancer writes text, client provides photos
included: Writing page text from a short client interview
acceptanceCriteria: Page text is written by the freelancer and reviewed by the client
Photos come from the client

options.label: Freelancer provides all (stock photos)
acceptanceCriteria: Every page has freelancer-written text and licensed stock photos
